Even though Zab Zebi is considered a heresy and an enemy of the rabbis, he's born into his family and will start to extend and systemize the teachings of Sabbu successful. He will have a lot of followers but much more importantly, he will become friends with European nobility, including the royal families of Austria and Russia. His followers will become important members of the European nobility, intellectuals, and bankers. And they've really gone on to conquer the world.

How did he inspire his followers to go conquer the world? He presented a new philosophy and religion that goes against Jewish Judaism. He doesn't consider himself a Jew and hates Jews. His new religion called Sabatian Frankism is based on success. Jesus came to our world to teach us that the material world doesn't matter; what matters is the divine spark in you, which will set you free and allow you to return to the moon.

We're here just to learn spirituality through pain and suffering. Then Jacob Frank thinks about this and says, "If God wants us to come here to learn wisdom, why do we have to suffer? Why can't we become kings ourselves by breaking the rules of this world, cheating, hacking the system, and becoming kings?" So he teaches this philosophy and religion to his followers and trains them on how to master this world.

We know what he says because many things were written down by his followers in Polish. A translation by Harris Lowitz from the University of UDO gives us these words, but we don't have access to his secret mystical magical teachings, the cabala. Think of his public teachings as a guide on how to conquer the world.

So we're going to study his mentality and teachings. He is a brilliant teacher because he tells religion and ideas through stories, which are powerful mechanisms of education in the world. A story goes: One Saturday, I went outside the city with some oranges and a knife. A learned Jewish scholar came along and asked why I was peeling oranges on that day. I answered truthfully but questioned his carrying a knife. He then revealed he had a penknife for bathing on Friday and putting on Sabbath clothing. The Jew cried out in amazement, "You cannot be a man, for if you are, then I am an ass." He begged me to come to him.
